additional_info.body:

According to RC, a similar issue was resolved with Sambath about a month ago from the same shipment (1700002067). The problem was identified with KF11 and KF12. Please discuss this with Sambath.
If the issue persists, it may be due to configuration corruption. Please provide the configuration file to RC for cFast flashing.
